name: Triramp
description: Three inks, each let down by its own ramp running a different way.

code.style: --rule: ( --rot: @pick(0deg, 90deg, 180deg, 270deg); @random(${shapeFrequency}) { background: var(--color1); :before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: var(--color2); -webkit-mask: repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, #000 0 14%, transparent 50%); mask: repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, #000 0 14%, transparent 50%); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: @p(var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-mask: repeating-linear-gradient(180deg, #000 0 14%, transparent 50%); mask: repeating-linear-gradient(180deg, #000 0 14%, transparent 50%); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } -webkit-transform: rotate(@var(--rot)); transform: rotate(@var(--rot)); } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
